self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Tales of the Tundra (R5): when the party's Elemental Types reach 3 or more, the wielder's Elemental Mastery is increased by 120.

en.flavor: A polearm used by those seeking to catch fish in the tundra. It lets none escape.

refinements.1: When there are at least 3 different Elemental Types in your party, Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>120.</r>
refinements.2: When there are at least 3 different Elemental Types in your party, Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>150.</r>
refinements.3: When there are at least 3 different Elemental Types in your party, Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>180.</r>
refinements.4: When there are at least 3 different Elemental Types in your party, Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>210.</r>
refinements.5: When there are at least 3 different Elemental Types in your party, Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>240.</r>

fr.flavor: Une lance utilisée par ceux qui cherchent à attraper du poisson dans la toundra. Elle ne laisse personne s'échapper.
